definitions.name: Elf
definitions.shortDescription: Elves are graceful, long-lived humanoids with keen senses and an affinity for magic.
definitions.fullDescription: The elf entry groups shared ancestry traits such as darkvision, keen senses, Fey Ancestry, and Trance. Available lineages remain separate related definitions.
definitions.searchText: elf darkvision keen senses fey ancestry trance

definitions.name: Paladin
definitions.shortDescription: A Paladin is a divine warrior empowered by sacred oaths.
definitions.fullDescription: Paladins combine martial training, healing, divine magic, and an oath. Their spellcasting uses Charisma and their class progression uses a d10 Hit Die.
definitions.searchText: paladin sacred oath divine martial charisma

definitions.name: Acolyte
definitions.shortDescription: A life of service in a temple or religious community shapes this background.
definitions.fullDescription: The Acolyte background provides Insight and Religion proficiency, two languages, starting equipment, and the Shelter of the Faithful feature.
definitions.searchText: acolyte insight religion languages shelter faithful

definitions.name: Cure Wounds
definitions.shortDescription: A creature you touch regains hit points through restorative magic.
definitions.fullDescription: The touched creature regains hit points. The healing increases for each spell slot level above first.
definitions.searchText: healing touch hit points higher level

definitions.name: Fireball
definitions.shortDescription: A bright streak blossoms into a fiery explosion at a point within range.
definitions.fullDescription: Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes fire damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one; higher-level spell slots increase the damage.
definitions.searchText: explosion sphere dexterity save fire damage higher level

definitions.name: Longsword
definitions.shortDescription: A versatile martial melee weapon that deals slashing damage.
definitions.fullDescription: A longsword deals 1d8 Slashing damage in one hand. The Versatile property raises its damage die to 1d10 when wielded with two hands.

definitions.name: Chain Mail
definitions.shortDescription: Heavy armor made from interlocking metal rings over quilted fabric.
definitions.fullDescription: Chain Mail provides Armor Class 16, requires Strength 13 to avoid a speed penalty, and imposes Disadvantage on Stealth checks.
definitions.searchText: chain mail heavy armor strength stealth
